name: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation
source:
You've been assigned to Required Synergy Workshop; a mandatory orientation module for new hires at Zaera-Kanzaki Corp. The exercises repeat. The metrics don't add up. Something in the walls is watching, and it isn't your supervisor.
A psychological horror visual novel about corporate compliance as cosmic horror. Branching choices quietly profile the player across three escalating loops.

Official website: https://dejadamnation.com
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4424600
YouTube: https://youtube.com/@moirexstudio
Developer: https://moirex.studio
